items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was a guy named Dora.

ctx.x: Yeah, cause Wickwood used to play at Varaday. I'm like Varaday there. Varaday. Hickman and them. Hickman and them.
I was a guy named Dora.
Yeah. But when did that amusement park was that built? Do you remember? I don't know. I found that out there. I went out there to Willie Twenton.
